title: Eighth and ninth book of Moses.
html_source: The first five books of the Bible – the Torah or Pentateuch – are traditionally ascribed to Moses. Some pamphlets were printed in German in the 18th century containing magical spells and incantations whose origins were said to be Mosaic. The pamphlets were later combined into book form.
